the-shell-manages-apps-as-cards.next: Integrate the continuous drawer/shade stream with the actual Rust renderer; then repeat reserved-board presentation, CPU/frame and physical touch acceptance.
the-shell-manages-apps-as-cards.rationale: Finger-tracked app entry, reversal and card expansion now have exact cross-build and headless QEMU pixel evidence. Continuous drawer/shade progress has QEMU sender and overlay-stacking proof; actual Rust receiver pixels and physical acceptance remain open. Existing board CPU/frame budgets are still unmet.

the-system-enables-proven-c908-extension.next: Run the remaining exact-image RVV/QEMU and reserved-board checks; keep the normal image unchanged until evidence passes.
the-system-enables-proven-c908-extension.rationale: The committed source and build evidence covers the first five tasks, while later target and physical gates remain unchecked.

the-handheld-presents-a-coherent-shell.next: Correct user-reported mechanical release and horizontal zoom detour; implement the mockup-aligned drawer, keyboard gestures and Wi-Fi Settings, then repeat physical acceptance.
the-handheld-presents-a-coherent-shell.rationale: The themed Rust shell with real wallpapers/icons is installed in test activation. User feedback identified awkward horizontal zoom, abrupt vertical settling, and an exposed Foot edge. The pixel-size fix is source-landed and separately proven on the board; motion and design corrections remain in progress.

the-shell-loads-omarchy-themes.next: Verify real theme switching and reboot persistence on the board; complete image previews and remaining appearance roles.
the-shell-loads-omarchy-themes.rationale: The built-in wallpapers, Yaru icons and themed Rust surfaces are installed. Exact-image QEMU checks verify real default/Latte wallpaper pixels, live-app visibility, coordinated rollback and Rust restart persistence. Native board captures confirm the default appearance; board switching, optical quality and full physical acceptance remain open.

the-shell-trials-vglite-composition.next: Resolve target format and presentation costs, then repeat paired GPU-versus-Pixman acceptance on the board before any default change.
the-shell-trials-vglite-composition.rationale: A committed GPU trial exists, but the comparison did not establish a faster accepted default compositor path.

the-handheld-evaluates-qtquick-and-quick.next: Resume the queued Qt Quick cross-build after integrated-shell builds, inspect target closure/QML configuration, then measure the plain app on the board before a Quickshell trial.
the-handheld-evaluates-qtquick-and-quick.rationale: Research and opt-in Qt probe source are on master. The build was deliberately interrupted to prioritize shell integration; dependency outputs are cached, but Qt and the probe have not built. No Qt/Quickshell board result or toolkit adoption is claimed.
